source.title: Example: J1939 SPN/FMI pair observed on a marine engine gateway

payload.description: Boost pressure above the normal operating band for this calibration.
typical_causes: Boost pressure control valve stuck open
Intake hose downstream of the compressor split

notes: spn 0..524287, fmi 0..31 (FMI is 5 bits). A pair that is already in the J1939 fault matrix is reported by validate_intake.py as kb_overlap — it is never merged twice.
